card: This PR replaces the Boost.Test library with an in-tree test runner and assertion framework located in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp}. Boost.Test introduces packaging and dependency overhead across depends and Guix, and its assertion macros often fail to print runtime operand values upon failure. Replacing the Boost test framework has been discussed across RFC #34666 and issue #8670, with related runner issues previously surfaced in #36045. Most file modifications are mechanical header updates handled by a scripted diff, with legacy BOOST_* macros maintained as compatibility shims for open pull requests. Boost.Test is dropped from CMake, depends, Guix, and vcpkg.
changed_since_previous: Added commits to resolve CI compilation and linter failures during test migration: suppressed a GCC 12 uninitialized variable warning in wallet spend_tests by inlining CRecipient construction, and addressed a clang-tidy warning in miniminer_tests.

enables: Future migration of individual test suites from BOOST_* aliases to native CHECK/REQUIRE/TEST_CASE macros.

evidence: Replacing Boost.Test has been a recurring goal tracked across issue #8670 ('Replacing Boost Test Framework') and RFC #34666 ('[rfc] Replacing Boost Unit Test Framework?').
Concrete issues with Boost.Test signal handling required workarounds like PR #36045 ('test: avoid undersized Boost.Test signal stacks').

The PR description notes that replacing Boost.Test 'helps us simplify depends and guix and use IWYU and clang-tidy within the tests more effectively' while eliminating multiple inconsistent assertion macros.
problem: Boost.Test adds external dependency and packaging overhead across Guix and depends, complicates tooling like IWYU and clang-tidy, and has suffered from platform issues such as undersized signal stacks (#36045). Furthermore, its varied assertion macros (such as BOOST_CHECK vs. BOOST_CHECK_EQUAL) inconsistently report evaluated operand values upon failure, creating an unintuitive debugging experience.

risk.why: Changes are isolated to unit test harnesses and test build configuration, where an error could disrupt CI or fail to catch regressions during testing but cannot affect production binaries or consensus.

scope_notes: The vast majority of touched files (~150 files) are single-line header substitutions executed by a scripted-diff commit (166dea04f5). The substantive logic is contained in the new runner in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp} and build-system adjustments.
summary: Replaces the external Boost.Test library with a custom in-tree unit test runner and assertion framework located in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp}. The new framework implements expression decomposition to automatically output operand values upon test failures while retaining backward-compatible BOOST_* macro shims to avoid conflicts with in-flight test pull requests. Boost.Test is dropped from the build system and packaging configurations across CMake, depends, Guix, and vcpkg.
